visual_identity.core_identity: Lanky regenerative cave giants with elongated arms, large claws, predatory faces, and tough sparse-textured skin.
visual_identity.silhouette: Tall narrow torso, hunched shoulders, very long arms, large clawed hands and feet.
visual_identity.head_features: Long coarse face, strong nose and brow, deep-set eyes, wide predatory mouth.
visual_identity.body_shape: Lean powerful giant anatomy with visibly elongated limbs rather than ogre-like bulk.
visual_identity.surface: Tough uneven skin with sparse bumps; no fur or reptilian scales.
visual_identity.limb_structure: Very long humanoid arms ending in large clawed hands, long powerful legs, and large clawed feet; limbs are lanky giant anatomy rather than ogre thickness or animal posture.

accuracy_checks: troll reads lanky rather than ogre-heavy
face reads predatory rather than goofy

known_failure_modes.symptom: troll becomes broad, heavy, and short-armed
known_failure_modes.correction: narrow the torso and lengthen arms toward knees while preserving clawed hands

known_failure_modes.symptom: troll gains tusks or orc armor
known_failure_modes.correction: remove tusks and military gear; restore predatory cave-giant anatomy

scene_identity.size_impression: Tall large cave giant whose reach and elongated limbs create scale more than torso width.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Hunched but bipedal and grounded, stalking with long arms hanging naturally, reaching around an obstacle, or braced in a confined opening.
behavior_style: stalking through cave or ruined passages
reaching around or over a large obstacle
guarding or feeding in a lair
squeezing through a broken stone opening while keeping long-limbed anatomy readable
environment_fit: large subterranean corridors, fissures, and broken openings that show reach and height
